name: study
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: immersive wide background for a web-based narrative game about Zhang Jian's life.
Primary request: create one landscape illustration, 1536x1024, of a late Qing scholar's study in Jiangnan in 1894, with no people.

Style/medium: exquisite traditional Chinese ink-wash painting fused with cinematic concept art; visibly painted, not a historical photograph; elegant spatial depth and delicate rice-paper texture.
Composition/framing: wide cinematic landscape, layered foreground, middle ground, and window vista; more scenic objects and architectural detail on the right; keep the left side quieter and lower contrast for later UI overlay without painting any UI.
Lighting/mood: soft volumetric dawn light through the wooden window, copper-gold sunlight against deep indigo and ink-green shadows; contemplative and calm.
Materials/textures: subtle ink diffusion on textured paper, worn timber, muted grey plaster, natural textile and paper surfaces, polished but restrained detail.
Constraints: the environment should feel credible for late Qing Jiangnan; no human figures; no readable writing on books, scrolls, or architecture; no text, no lettering, no UI, no logos, no watermark; no modern objects; no fake archival or photographic treatment.

name: adult
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: a standalone transparent character sprite for an illustrated historical visual novel, portrait canvas 1024x1536.
Input image: the referenced black-and-white historical portrait of Zhang Jian is a facial identity reference only; interpret him artistically, not as a fabricated historical photograph. Preserve the same recognizable face across the age versions: lean East Asian man, prominent arched dark eyebrows, alert almond-shaped eyes, high cheekbones, long dignified face, distinctive mustache and chin beard.
Style/medium: polished Japanese visual novel character art blended with refined Chinese gongbi portrait painting; delicate clean linework, subtle natural skin texture, graceful anatomy and soft cel-shaded light; mature historical character proportions and restrained realism.
Composition/framing: one man standing, front-facing with the torso gently turned in a three-quarter view, looking toward the player. Frame the complete head and cap down to the thighs, with generous transparent margins around the silhouette; do not crop the head, hands, elbows or thighs. One hand holds a closed rolled book scroll at waist height; the other arm rests naturally. Quiet, composed pose.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background, clean isolated cutout edges; no backdrop, no ground plane, no shadow rectangle, no character-card background, no graphic panel or frame. No text, logo, watermark, UI, lettering or captions. No modern glasses, no official court regalia, no official rank badge, no modern accessories. This is a character cutout, not a scene or environment painting.
Primary request: Zhang Jian aged 41–55, a slim, composed middle-aged East Asian man, with a short black mustache and neatly restrained short chin beard. Keep the facial identity of the supplied elderly portrait, plausibly rejuvenated rather than changing him into a different person. His expression is gentle, calm and firm, with subtle weathering around the eyes.
Clothing: a simple dark teal-blue late Qing changshan long robe with a stand collar, understated cloth fastenings and natural drape, and a plain black round cap. No official ornaments or court robe.
Lighting/color: soft, evenly legible character illumination, warm natural skin, deep teal-blue robe, fine golden warmth at the light edges; keep colors restrained.
